title: UPCS: Unbiased Persona Construction for Dialogue Generation
measurement_description: The paper evaluates its ability to mitigate biases in generated personas for dialogue systems. This includes mitigating stereotypes related to religious groups, using the example of avoiding preconceived notions about the practices and needs of Muslim users. Religion is treated as a component of the 'Cultural Background' dimension in the persona construction.
findings: The paper's proposed framework, UPCS, was found to effectively reduce overall bias in personalized dialogues. While not isolating religious bias specifically in its results, the framework is designed to mitigate it as part of a broader set of potential biases (e.g., race, gender, religion). The example of avoiding stereotypes about Muslim users illustrates the type of religious bias the system aims to prevent.
